verdict.rationale: Codex is built around OpenAI's own GPT-5.3-Codex model family, with docs and community discussion referencing different Codex model variants (e.g., gpt-5.3-codex, gpt-5.3-codex-spark) but no evidence of selecting models from other providers like Anthropic or Google within the product itself. Community comments treat Claude/Gemini as separate tools users switch to outside Codex, not as options within it.
